description: Exact first-state P activation using all original Obsiss rows for the French greeting prompt; no candidate generation and no target answer.
architecture: Original eSonde v6 checkpoint, 1,000,000 Obsiss, dimension 16, exact batched F_h/F_p operator, separate E_C CountSketch and E_O semantic observations. The first-state P operator returns paired Q without claiming diffusion convergence.
pipeline: Tokenize the user prompt into local/global feature vectors
Compute exact F_h/F_p on every row in 123 batches of 8,192
Build P published state and paired Q context
Hash all published/Q rows and report exact row coverage
command: PYTHONPATH=src OMP_NUM_THREADS=3 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 ESONDE_INDEX_WORKERS=3 python experiments/profile_full_population_first_state_P_20261118.py
interpretation: The full-population first-state operator completed in 2.071 seconds in this environment. This is a direct, repeatable operator measurement; it does not establish neighbour-diffusion convergence or response quality.

consequences.theoretical: P defines a complete deterministic all-row F_h/F_p evaluation and a paired Q context. It is not a fixed point.
consequences.conceptual: First-state P and first-state R are a symmetric, explicitly distinguished operator mode. The exact convergent mode remains a separate lab variant.
consequences.operational: Use first_state as the default runtime experiment while preserving the full convergent path for future exact optimisation and ablation.

conclusion: PASS for exact all-row first-state activation and latency; no statement about chat coherence.
